journey.name: AX-03 The list and the form stay usable at 200% font scale
journey.description:
AX-01 checks that the descriptions exist. This checks that the screen is still operable for the user who needs them: at 200% every row grows to two lines, and every control has to stay reachable rather than pushed off the edge or under a neighbour.
It is also the only journey that ever scrolls. FR-01 asks for a scrollable list and the four seed rows never fill a screen — not even at 200%, which was measured: on a 1080x2280 device all four still fit. So the journey creates two rows of its own to overflow the viewport, which is cheaper than the fifty-row scale journey `TEST-PLAN.md` still lists as future work, and enough to prove the list scrolls and keeps its controls when it does.
The editor half covers the same risk on a Column that already has verticalScroll: the Save button lives in the app bar, and a doubled font must not push it into the Back control or off the bar.
Set the scale before launching — a running app is recreated by the change, which is TH-02's scenario, not this one. Reset it afterwards.
Preconditions: adb shell settings put system font_scale 2.0 adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0 # afterwards adb shell settings put system font_scale 1.0
